outcomes.excerpt: Create and update a record, assign related work, inspect and resolve it; preserve binding and chronology, verify metrics, cancellation and concurrency.

tasks.excerpt: - [ ] T001 Implement the confirmed record operations and independent functional readback.

criteria.surface: Record editor and related record handlers
criteria.assertion: Create/update/assign/inspect expected records; reload and read back exact stable identities and permitted changes.
Selected parent and related-record identities survive save, navigation and reload.
Allowed resolution persists; invalid transitions reject without unintended changes.
Valid chronology persists; reversed intervals reject without changing the retained before-state.
Recompute counts and durations from retained records and compare exact expected values after reload.
Cancel an unsaved edit; confirm persisted records remain unchanged.
A stale save cannot overwrite a newer retained record version.
